module_summary: themes.cpp is the theme loader: it reads conf_theme.cfg (built-in buffers or disk/tar), resolves the active multi-view prefix, parses the twelve element families (main/info x games, apps, favs, vcd, favsVcd, favsApps) into linked element lists, validates them (default background/list, decorator links, cover-cache splits, text rooms), loads textures, glyph sets and hint settings, and swaps gTheme under the GUI lock. It also holds the ThemeCatalog (disk theme list, selected id, settings name list) behind thm* C forwarders and the view switch / reload entry points. themeviews.cpp is the host-testable config logic for multi-view themes: view scan and choice, picks and L3 cycling, block fallback resolution, SD/HD and alt-background key rewriting, and synthesis of fallback views from built-in templates. uidraw.cpp draws icon+caption hints and computes hint-row alignment for gui, dialogs and theme hint elements.

findings.title: The twelve element families are listed by hand eleven times in themes.cpp (and once more in themeelems.cpp)
findings.problem: theme_t's 12 theme_elems_t members are not contiguous (include/themes.h:200-234), so every pass over all families spells them out: seven 12-line call blocks (306-317, 561-572, 576-587, 610-621, 624-635, 957-968, themeelems.cpp:871-882), an 8-line block (544-551) and four hand-written pointer arrays (196-198, 334-336, 1122-1124, 1855-1858). Adding a family means editing ~12 places.
findings.fix: Add one static helper that fills a theme_elems_t *[12] for a theme (exported through themeint.h for themeelems.cpp) and turn each block into a loop; merge the coverage and text-room passes (561-587) into one loop. Keep the 8-family subset at 544-551 as a loop that skips thmIsFavKindFamily.
findings.justification: The helper (about 8 lines) replaces about 75 lines of repeated per-family calls and removes the risk of one list missing a family when the next one is added.
findings.benefit: ~65 source lines net (INFERRED: 7 x 12-line blocks become 2-line loops = -70, 4 arrays shrink to 1 line = -6, 8-line block -5, helper +8); negligible ELF change.
findings.evidence: Read every cited block; grep -n favsAppsInfoElems over src/: themes.cpp 189,198,317,336,357,525,556,572,587,621,635,968,1124,1393,1653,1858; themeelems.cpp 882,1407,1427; menusys.cpp 2525-2526,2869. include/themes.h:200-234 shows the members interleaved with other fields, so no pointer arithmetic over them is possible.

findings.title: thmLoad re-zeroes about 40 fields right after memset(newT, 0), and sets loadingIconCount only to overwrite it
findings.problem: newT is memset to 0 at 1366, then 24 first/last pointers, parsingFavKindFamily, gameCacheCount, wallpaper, five items-list pointers, coverflow/psbbnFlow/grid, coverflowCoverOffset, loadingIcon, every textures[].Mem (1680-1681), logoFrameCount and hintsHide/hintsColumn are stored as 0/NULL again. loadingIconCount at 1410 is overwritten unconditionally at 1712 and nothing reads it in between (only reader is guioverlay.cpp:60).
findings.fix: Delete the zero/NULL stores at 1371-1396, 1399-1409, 1679-1681, 1690, 1768, 1770 and the dead store at 1410; keep the non-zero defaults (useDefault, usedHeight, artGeneration, wallpaperWanted, hintsLabels, hintsSpacing).
findings.benefit: ~44 source lines removed (counted from the cited ranges); a few dozen bytes of .text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read themes.cpp:1354-1847. grep -rn '->textures\[' src/: only themes.cpp writes newT->textures, all at or after 1684, so nothing is loaded before the 1680 loop. grep -rn loadingIconCount src/: themes.cpp:1410,1712 and guioverlay.cpp:60 (reader, on gTheme after publish).

findings.title: ThemeCatalog is a single-instance class reached only through one-line thm* forwarders; its count() accessor and two includes of its header are unused
findings.problem: The only instance is static gCatalog in themes.cpp; every external caller uses the C API (thmAddElements, thmReinit, thmGetValue, thmSetGuiValue, thmGetGuiValue, thmFindGuiID, thmGetGuiList, thmGetFilePath), each a one-line forwarder, and readEntryCallback is a trampoline back into gCatalog. ThemeCatalog::count() has no caller. coverflow.cpp and themeelems.cpp include themecatalog.h but use nothing from it (both include themes.h directly).
findings.fix: Drop the class: make themeId_, count_, themes_ and names_ file-static in themes.cpp, implement the thm* functions directly, pass readEntry to listDir, delete count(), delete themecatalog.h and its two unused includes, and adjust the source-text test that extracts the class.
findings.benefit: ~55 source lines (INFERRED: header 35 lines -> 0, 8 forwarders and the trampoline ~35 lines -> 0, file-static state +5); no ELF change expected beyond inlined forwarders.
findings.evidence: git grep -n 'ThemeCatalog|themecatalog.h' (excluding docs): only themes.cpp methods, themecatalog.h, includes at coverflow.cpp:5 and themeelems.cpp:5, and .github/scripts/test_psbbn_flow.py:265-314 / test_udpfs_themes.py:218 (source-text tests). grep gCatalog over src/: themes.cpp only. No '.count()' call on gCatalog anywhere (themes.cpp:140,255 are image_cache_t::count).

findings.title: guiDrawIconAndText duplicates guiDrawIconAndLiteralText except for the _l() lookup
findings.problem: The two functions are line-for-line identical (icon width, VCENTER offset, rmDrawPixmap, x advance, fntRenderString) except that the first renders _l(textId) and the second a caller string.
findings.fix: Make guiDrawIconAndText a one-line call: return guiDrawIconAndLiteralText(iconId, _l(textId), font, x, y, color).
findings.benefit: ~19 source lines removed; one copy of the draw code (~100-150 bytes .text, INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read uidraw.cpp:1-86 in full and compared both bodies. Callers: guiDrawIconAndLiteralText at guimodal.cpp:235-237; guiDrawIconAndText 34 calls in dia.cpp, diaeditors.cpp, guimodal.cpp, guisettings.cpp, guioverlay.cpp, gui.cpp, themeelems.cpp. Only the 'HACK' comment at 27 differs.

findings.title: Copy-paste per slot/group in validateBackgroundElems, isDecoratorCoverImage and the addGUIElem ItemsList branches
findings.problem: validateBackgroundElems has two identical 7-line blocks differing only in mainElems/infoElems; isDecoratorCoverImage repeats one 5-line check for gamesItemsList, appsItemsList, favsItemsList and vcdItemsList; addGUIElem has four identical initBasic(42,42,400,360)+initItemsList pairs (filtered, apps, favs, vcd) that differ only in which slot pointer receives elem.
findings.fix: validateBackgroundElems: one small static that prepends a default background to a family, called for main and (when non-empty) info. isDecoratorCoverImage: loop over a 4-entry array of the slot pointers. addGUIElem: pick the target slot (NULL for filtered or fav-kind lists, games keeps its own 0,0,DIM_UNDEF defaults) and build the list once.
findings.evidence: Read themes.cpp:98-160, 214-246, 717-753 and compared the blocks; the slot order games, apps, favs, vcd is the same at 221-243, 534-537, 590-593 and 737-753.

findings.title: thmLoad re-implements thmReadViewTemplate for the built-in theme
findings.problem: The four-way configReadBuffer selection at 1433-1440 is the body of thmReadViewTemplate (1341-1351) with builtinView for view.
findings.benefit: 7 source lines removed; a few dozen bytes .text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read both blocks; same four buffers, same order, same default (conf_theme_OPL_cfg). thmReadViewTemplate is static and called only at 1487.

findings.title: thmLoadResource takes a psm parameter it never uses
findings.problem: The body (1063-1073) never reads psm; all 11 call sites pass GS_PSM_CT32.
findings.fix: Delete the psm parameter and the GS_PSM_CT32 argument at every call site.
findings.benefit: No line change; one register argument less per call (INFERRED, a few bytes).
findings.evidence: thmLoadResource is static; grep -n thmLoadResource themes.cpp: definition 1061 and calls 1261, 1703, 1717, 1721, 1733, 1745, 1749, 1750, 1797, 1801, 1811; no match in .github/scripts or tests.

findings.title: Eight includes in themes.cpp that nothing in the file uses
findings.problem: pad.h, sound.h, favsupport.h, vcdsupport.h (comment claims vcdDisplayName), libview.h (comment claims libViewActive), rabadge.h, <time.h> and <math.h> are included, but none of their functions, macros or types appear in themes.cpp; the commented users live in themeelems.cpp now.
findings.fix: Delete the eight includes (and the RETROACHIEVEMENTS #ifdef around rabadge.h).
findings.benefit: 10 source lines; slightly faster compile; no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Listed the functions/macros declared in each header and grepped themes.cpp for them (getKey, pad*, sfx*/bgm*/audio*, fav*/recent*, vcd*(, ps1Row*, libView*/libList*, raBadge*, time_t/struct tm, sqrt/floor/ceil/M_PI): only the include lines match. Not compiled: a type pulled in transitively by one of them is INFERRED absent.

findings.title: NULL guards for impossible arguments in the static cover-cache split helpers
findings.problem: isDecoratorCoverImage, cloneImageCache, replaceSharedCoverCache, splitFilteredDecoratorCoverCaches and separateVcdCoverCache are static and only called with a live theme (validateGUIElems(newT) or a caller that already dereferenced it), non-NULL family addresses, gameImage already tested non-NULL (272, 390) and a source cache already tested non-NULL (294-297, 390-400).
findings.fix: Delete these guards; keep the list/extended checks in splitDecoratorCoverCache, whose argument can be a slot pointer.
findings.evidence: All five are static; callers read: 245/272/391 (isDecoratorCoverImage), 301/403 (cloneImageCache), 306-317/408-414 (replaceSharedCoverCache, &theme->X and &replacementAssigned), 599 and 603 (from validateGUIElems, called only at 1660 with newT from a checked malloc).

findings.title: Stale comments describing the removed built-in <Coverflow> theme, the old family count and a stranded thmLoad contract
findings.problem: <Coverflow> is no longer a theme (rebuildNames 1886-1897 lists only <OPL> and disk themes; it is a view), yet 1530-1540, 1805-1808, 2045-2056 ('id count_ + 1') and 2087-2089 ('the flows above count_') describe it as a separate built-in theme. 180-181 says 8 families while the code walks 12; 986 says four element lists (twelve). 1180-1183 documents thmLoad's return value but sits above the glyph-set block, 170 lines before thmLoad. uidraw.h:10 says 'linked list' for array arguments; themecatalog.h:6 names src/themes.cpp.
findings.fix: Delete the history in these comments and keep one line each where a rule still applies (built-in view cfgs must not set colour keys; only disk themes have paths); move the return-value sentence above thmLoad.
findings.benefit: ~20 source lines of comment removed; no binary change.
findings.evidence: Read all cited comments against the code: rebuildNames 1881-1898, filePath 2085-2097, families at 196-201, thmFree 956-968, thmLoad at 1353. grep '<Coverflow>' over src/: the remaining live uses are the legacy-name mapping (settingsio.cpp:1610, themeviews.cpp:45, themes.cpp:2227).

findings.title: thmBlockPresent re-implements thmViewBlockPresent's presence rule
findings.problem: Both build '<name>_enabled' and '<name>_type' keys and apply the same rule (switched off = present, else present iff a _type exists); thmBlockPresent only adds the unfiltered-ItemsList claimsSlot flag.
findings.fix: Have thmBlockPresent return 0 when thmViewBlockPresent is 0 and compute claimsSlot from the _type lookup only.
findings.evidence: Read both functions; thmBlockPresent is static, called at 859, 881 and 903. thmViewBlockPresent is exported (themeviews.h:38) and already used by themeviews.cpp itself and the host tests.
